mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 6 months indicates an easing monetary policy, which reduces the risk-free rate and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 6 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5% per annum, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2.0% and the monthly inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 0.3%, it signals a policy dilemma where the Fed may tighten to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement monetary easing, which boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) over the prior 6 months indicates a robust economic expansion, which supports higher corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017=100), it signals a contraction in the industrial sector, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline below 1500 thousand units and residential investment (RSAFS) falls below 650000 million dollars, it signals a weakening housing market, which reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (annualized), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
